title: Concept: JavaScript ORM query exception disclosed in a response
description: JavaScript ORMs name the model, the SQL and the bound parameters in their exception message, and their class names are distinctive enough to identify the stack. Rendering one to a client hands over the schema and the exact query that failed, which is more than a database error: it is a description of the data model.
applicability: Responses generated by a Node.js service using Sequelize, Prisma, TypeORM or Knex.
risk: The caller learns model names, table columns and the bound parameter values of a failed query, which exposes both the schema and the data being handled at failure time.
